As a national special relic site, they are part of the UNESCO World Heritage complex, attracting tourists and cultural enthusiasts from around the world. The site is an important destination where visitors can explore history and appreciate ancient artistic values, immersing themselves in the cultural heritage of Vietnam.

In cultural life, the Stone Dragons of Kinh Thien Palace play a significant role, serving as a backdrop for cultural events and major ceremonies of the capital. The surrounding spacious environment, with the open courtyard and weathered gray stone, adds to the solemn and easily recognizable composition, making the site an iconic representation of Vietnamese cultural identity.
